tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin bzhugs so// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /gsal stong spros bral bde chen ngang / /gdul bya'i dgos 'dod skongs mdzad pa'i/ /bka' drin can gyi zhabs btud nas/ /rang gzhan gsal 'debs don du yang / /khyad 'phags 'char sgo ngos 'dzin bri/ /'od gsal la bzhi ste/ gsal ba'i 'char sgo dang / mi rtog pa'i dang / bde ba'i dang / zung 'jug pa'i 'char sgo'o/ /dang po ni/ gnyid du song ba yin byas pas/ rang gi mdun gyi dngos po thams cad gsal sing nge mthong ba/ ma song ba yin byas pas/ sad tsa na nag thib kyis 'gro ba dang / yang rna bar mdo 'don pa dang / sngags 'dren pa thos pa la bsten nas rig pa la gsal ba dang / yang zla ba gcig shar 'dug snyam pa dkar lam me ba dang / yang zla ba shar 'dug pa la dkar zhing dwangs pa dang / yang nyi zla shar byung snyam pa la 'od zer gsal seng ba mig ltar mi bzod pa dang / yang rang gi snying kha nas mar me 'bar ba lta bu dang / yang dmar kyem kyem pa 'byung / res mi gsal ba srin bu me khyer lta bu dang / yang rang gi khang pa na mar me gsal po btang 'dug snyam pa dang / yang me lce lhab lhab 'bar gyin 'dug snyam pa lta bu dang / yang rang gi sngas kha na mar me gsal po/ skong bu dang / snum dang / sdong bu bcas pa gsal sing sing ba mthong ba dang / yang nyin par dus su dngos po phran tshegs stor ba la brten nas rmi lam gyi dus su zhe sdang skyes pa la brten nas/ rtog pa gsal la rags pa dang / yang gnyid cig kyang med par khams dwangs pa dang / sha rtsi dkar la dwangs pa 'ong bas/ de la rlung 'dzin pa'o/ /la las khams 'dus su 'dzin pa'o/ /ngo ma shes na gang du bzung ba der 'gyur nas 'gro bla ma dam pas zin na 'od gsal du 'gyur nas 'gro gsung ngo / /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rlung sems dbu mar 'dzud pa dang / rtsa mdud 'grol ba dang / rnam shes mtha' yas dang / mi rtog par song ba'o/

/dang po gnyid du 'gro kha'am song tsa na rna ba zi rong rong thib thib song nas nag yor yor byung ba lta bu la 'jir 'jir gnon pa de la nga 'dres gnon 'dug snyam nas sngags bzlas/ lha bsgoms kyang mthur 'gro 'gro ba 'ong bas/ de la bla mas ngo sprad pa'i 'od gsal der 'dug snyam pa byas la steng rlung bzung / mi rtog pa la bzhag pas/ rlung dbu mar tshud nas 'od gsal 'ba' zhig du 'gro ba yin gsung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ gnyid du lhan song ba dang / 'dar yed yed la/ yan lag phros song nas/ 'dom gang do tsam 'phags nas 'gro/ dar cig rgyal 'ong bas/ de'i dus su mi 'gul bar dar cig bzhag pas rtsa mdud grol nas/ de phyin chad sgom mi dgos par 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'gro/ don grub pa yin gsung ngo / /de yang drang srong ngam/ rgyal nad dang nor nas 'gro bas bye brag phyed pa gal che gsung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ rang gi rnam shes 'di nam mkha' la sra ya ge pa dang / sems nyid nang du bsdu yis mi 'dus pa 'byung bas/ de la gcod kyi dbyings rig bsre/ chos sku mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag pas/ 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'gro gsung ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ tho rangs sam/ nang zhogs sngas pa dang / gsal ba 'dres pa'i 'dar yed yed pa 'ong bas/ de la glang po che'i lta stangs kyis mig cer bltas nas bzhag pas/ gsal stong spros pa thams cad dang bral bar lhan gyis rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ zag bcas dang / zag med do/ /dang po ni/ tho rangs lta bu lus bde phril phril la shes pa gsal ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshan mo gnyid kyi dus su yang / 'dzin med kyi shes pa 'ba' zhig tu 'char la/ nyin par yang 'dzin med kyi bde gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'char ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ nyin mtshan thams cad gsal stong / bde chen zung 'jug rgyun chad med par 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar nyin mtshan thams cad du gsal la mi rtog pa'i ngang du ma yengs par bsgoms pas/

lo'am zla ba tsam gyis rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa yin gsung ngo / /khyad 'phags 'char sgo ngos 'dzin 'di/ sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung bzhin bkod/ /dge ba de yis sems can rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin ces bya ba/ /sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung bzhin du/ /a yis seng ges yi ger bkod pa'o/ /shu bhaṃ/ /'di yang 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ ༄༅/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi/ zhabs la gus pas btud byas nas/ 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos bzung ba/ mdo rgyud bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri/ de la gnyid gti mug 'od gsal gyis sbyang bar bya ste/ dgyes rdor las/ gnyid ni spang bar mi bya ste/ /dbang po rnams ni dgag mi bya/ /zhes so/ /de yang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba gdod ma nas dag pa ste/ mahā ma ya las/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag cing rnyog ma med/ /ces so/ /dha ka ye shes las/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal bas/ /dngos po med pa'i 'du shes sgom/ /brgyad stong pa las/ sems ni sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes pas/ rang bzhin ni gnas pa'i 'od gsal lo/ /de ji ltar nyams su blang ba ni/ bla mas sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal du ngo sprad pa de rtag tu nyams su blang bar bya ste/ bdag med 'dris pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems ni 'od gsal ba/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu sgom/ /zhes so/ de ltar 'od gsal bsgoms pas rgyal ba'i sku 'grub ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar nga'i sku 'di ni/ /'od kyis bsam du med par 'grub/ /ces pas/ de yang gnas dben par skyo shas mos gus sogs gnad dgus nyams su blangs pas/ ji lta ba bzhin du 'char te/ rin chen rgya mtsho'i rgyud phyi ma las/ /bla ma'i byin brlabs 'od gsal ni/ /tho rangs tshe'am dus gzhan du/ /gsal stong bde chen dbyer med pa'i/ /'char sgo dam pa'i zhal la dris/

/ces pa la bzhi ste/ gsal ba'i 'od gsal dang / mi rtog pa'i dang / bde ba'i dang / dbyer med pa'i 'od gsal lo/ /de yang 'od gsal ngos zin ma zin goms pa'i khyad ma gtogs pa kun la 'char/ khyad par tho rangs nyi shar gyi dus su ngos bzung na bla ste/ gnyid du song byas pas nye 'khor gyi bya byed thams cad mthong ba dang / sgra grags tshad gsal por thos pa'o/ /gnyid du ma song byas pas sangs rgyur 'gyur ro/ /nang nas phyi'i yul khams rgya chen po gsal ba dang / zhing khams gsal na la sogs yul snang gtan la phebs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du nyi zla'i zer lta bu shar ba dang / zla ba'i 'od skya 'od de ba lta bu dang / nyi ma'i mdangs gsal ba'am/ de bzhin du gsal zhing dro ba dang / gangs ri'i mdangs lta bu dang / shel gyi ri rtsar 'dug snyam pa dang / snying kha nas 'od mar me 'bar ba lta bu dang / 'od lnga'am dkar po mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'am/ mar me gcig tu gyur pas gsal bar gyur pa dang / khang pa'i nang 'od kyis khengs pa dang / skar khung nas 'od byung ba dang / phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi gang yang rung ba nas skya seng seng 'byung ba dang / 'od kyi glog 'khyug pa dang / srin bu me khyer lta bu dang / thig le 'pho ba nyi zla sgra dang 'od dang bcas nas mdun du byung ba dang / srog chags gang yang rung ba dang / sa rdo ri brag gang yang rung ba las me 'bar nas 'od du gyur pa dang / skyes pa dang bud med kyis mun khung du sgron me bteg pa dang / ri'am khang pa la sogs pa 'od phung cig tu gyur pa dang / /me long ngam rin po che las 'od 'phro ba dang / chu bo chen po'i dkyil lam/ rba klong 'od tu gnas pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo / /dngos po phra mo khyer ba la sogs pa chags sdang gi yul bag tsam la zhe sdang rags pa/ gsal la dwangs pa nyin par bas bdun 'gyur gyi che ba 'byung ba ni zhe sdang dang 'dres pa'i 'od gsal te/

/gser dang g.ya' lta bur 'char ro/ /yang 'ga' zhig la gti mug 'od gsal du song nas nyin mtshan kun tu gnyid med la khams bzang ba sha dkar la dwangs pa 'byung ngo / /de la rang dang gzhan gyis rlung dang gdon la sogs par bzung bas der 'gyur zhing khams 'dus su 'gro'o/ /de yang bla mas ngo sprad nas nges shes bskyed na gsal ba'i 'od gsal du 'gyur ro/ /mdor na gnyid khung du grogs po la sogs pas mdo 'don pa dang / sngags bzlas pa/ gtam sna tshogs gleng ba/ 'dab chags sna tshogs skad 'byin pa sogs ji lta ba bzhin du thos te/ de nyin par gnyid du ma song ba las bdun 'gyur gyis gsal zhing dwangs ba 'byung ngo / /de la 'od gsal mthar thug gi dpe ni/ ston kha'i nam mkha' dwangs pa la/ nyi ma shar ba'i mdangs phog pa ltar snang ba thams cad je gsal je gsal/ gsal stong 'dzin med 'ba' zhig tu 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang ting nge 'dzin dam pa'i rgyud las/ gsal ba'i 'od gsal du ma 'char/ /de yang dpag tu med pa 'byung / /ces so/ ༈ /gnyis pa mi rtog pa'i 'od gsal la lnga ste/ rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i 'od gsal/ rtsa 'dab grol ba'i/ rnam shes mtha' yas pa'i/ gnyid dang gti mug 'dres pa'i/ mi rtog pa gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i 'od gsal lo/ /dang po ni/ mi nag po dang / rlung tshub dang / ri la sogs pas mnan pa dang / gos sogs kyis kha sim pa lta bu thib thib dang / rna ba zi rong rong pa 'byung / de gdon la sogs pa yin na dmigs pa gang yang rung bas sel lo/ /'od gsal yin na de rnams sgom gyin cher 'gro bas/ de la bla mas ngo sprod pa'i 'od gsal du 'dug snyam du bsam nas 'di la ma yal bar bya dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang nas 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag pas stobs chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa 'dab grol bas 'dar yed yed pa dang / lus 'dug sa nas 'phar ba 'byung bas/ de'i dus su rlung dang 'od gsal 'dres pas nyin mtshan dbyer med kyi 'od gsal 'char bar 'gyur ro/

/gsum pa ni/ lus sems gnyis nam mkha' la gnas nas lus sems 'bral ba yin snyam pa'i snang ba 'byung nas/ da ni sems 'di yang nam mkha' ltar mtha' yas 'gro bar 'dug snyam nas sngangs skrag chen po 'byung ngo / /de'i dus su mal chen po byas rkang brkyang lag brkyang byas la nyal la sems dang nam mkha' bsres la nam mkha' gar khyab tu rig pas khyab par bsams nas rig stong dbyer med du bzhag pas/ lus sems dang nam mkha' 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'od gsal 'char ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gnyid du song ma song gang gi yang rtog pa med par mtshan mo thal na'ang de kar 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa ni/ rmi lam zin nas 'od gsal sgom pa'am/ 'od gsal shar bar shes pa'am nyin par du byas nas/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i dus der/ lus kyis sa gnon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bya ba dang / glang chen lta stangs bya dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pas rlung cung zad bzung ba dang / mtshan mo thams cad 'od gsal phyag chen du 'char ro/ /de yang rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i 'od gsal brjod med ci yang mi rtog pa 'ba' zhig tu 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa bde ba'i 'od gsal la gsum te/ zag bcas bde ba'i 'od gsal dang / 'dres pa'i dang / zag med kyi dang ngo / /dang po rang nyid bde ba rgyas pa'i stobs kyis nyin par dang mtshan mo gnyid kyi dus su/ /bud med kyi gsang gnas sam/ brla'i sha'am/ gzhan yang chags pa spyod pa mthong ba'am/ rang lus reg pa'am/ sbyor ba byas pa'am/ yi dam yab yum gsal por bsgom pa'i gsang gnas la dmigs pa gtad pa la sogs pas rkyen byas nas/ bde ba chen po skyes te thig le 'chor la khad pa byung ba'i dus su/ /steng rlung cung zad mar la bsdigs la/ de nas 'og rlung bskum byas nas thig le drangs pas/ yul sems dang snang ba thams cad bde bar shar nas/ lus 'gul mi phod pa dang / sha bcad kyang bde bar 'char bar 'gyur bas/

de'i dus su bde ba mi rtog par btsud pas zag bcas bde ba'i 'od gsal 'char ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bde ba rgyas la 'dzin pa med pa'i 'od gsal ni/ zag bcas zag med 'dres pa'i 'od gsal lo/ /gsum pa ni/ nyin par bde ba rgyas pa de stong par rgyas gdab cing / bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis mtshan mo dang snga dro gnyid du 'gro ba'i tshe na/ bde ba de la sems gtad nas gnyid log pa dang / dang po lus bde/ de nas sems bde/ de nas thams cad bde chen sha stag tu 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /des nyin mtshan kun tu snang sems thams cad bde bar shar/ spyir chags sdang thams cad rang dag rang grol la 'gro la/ khyad par du pho mo'i chags sdang phrag dog thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni bde ba rgyas shing ma nyams pa la 'byung ngo / /des zag bcas ma nyams pas 'od gsal phyogs med du 'char ba ni 'bras bu'i chos so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gong ltar gsal ba bde ba mi rtog pa gsum/ res 'ga' gang shas che bar 'char te/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po ni gsal la 'dzin pa med pa 'di 'di kho nar 'dug snyam pa dang / de bzhin bde la zhen pa med pa 'di kho nar 'dug snyam pa dang / mi rtog pa gsal bar 'chags 'dug snyam pa 'byung ngo / /de ni gsal ba sprul sku/ mi rtog chos sku/ bde ba longs sku yin yang zung du ma chud de/ 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i 'od gsal zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po ni/ lus bde stong / snang ba thams cad snang stong / sems rig stong zung 'jug tu 'char ro/ /zung 'jug gsum po de tha dad ma yin te/ dus skad cig ma'am dus thams cad du gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde la 'dzin pa med pa/ snang la zhen pa med pa gsum dbyer med zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan gyi 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni yod med/ bzang ngan/ mtha' dbus skye 'chi dgag sgrub la sogs pa'i bsam brjod thams cad dang bral bar rtogs par bya'o/

'bras bu'i lung ni tshig mangs bas 'jigs pas 'dir ma bris so/ /de'ang mdo rgyud mtha' dag las lta bar bya'o/ /dad ldan shes rab mos gus nyams myong ldan/ /bshes gnyen dam pas skul phyir yi ger bkod/ /de la gnas gsum mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol/ /'di don mngon gyur gzhan don lhun grub shog/ //'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin rdzogs so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
